video_title: GIlbert Arenas says Wemby is not even CLOSE to Jokic and Shai at the moment 👀

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas compares Luka Doncic and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.excerpt: I ain't even like foreigners until I got one.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Who better, Luka Doncic or Shai Gilgeous-Alexander?

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: I'm going to say, I'm a Laker fan. Luka. I ain't even like foreigners until I got one. They both foreigners. They trying to take over here, all them fake narratives. And then once I got one, man, you know what, these foreigners ain't too bad, baby. I love me a good old foreigner.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas evaluates Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's MVP-level performance
quotes.excerpt: Luka was first team all-NBA since he stepped in this bitch.
quotes.quote: Until last year, when Shai won another MVP, another this and that, Luka was in front of him. I remember Luka was first team all-NBA since he stepped in this bitch. And Shai, playing with the Clippers, he had to catch up. And his catch up was like, damn. You swept, you scoring champ, MVP, Western Conference Finals MVP, champion, Finals MVP. You took all that in one year. And then you came back and you damn near did it again. Western Conference Finals MVP, MVP. So you got these trophies that he don't have, so you jumped in front of him.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas names Nikola Jokic as the best basketball player
quotes.excerpt: There is a guy in Texas. Jokic is the best basketball player.
quotes.quote: The best basketball player, I would say there is a guy in Texas. Jokic is the best basketball player. Now, if Embiid is healthy, which, you know, that's a bad motherfucker too. Embiid is not in that conversation. But if Embiid is healthy, he is a bad motherfucker too.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas and Theo Pinson discuss Victor Wembanyama's potential
quotes.excerpt: That motherfucker Wemby close, Gil.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: That motherfucker Wemby close, Gil. We had this conversation more than that. That motherfucker Wemby close, Gil.

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: Not yet. No. Not even. Close. Close. Not even close. Not at all.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas analyzes Victor Wembanyama's offensive development
quotes.excerpt: When Shaquille O'Neal was in his peak, he was trying to break the rim on you.
quotes.quote: When Shaquille O'Neal was in his peak, he was trying to break the rim on you. He ain't taking no 20-footers, he ain't taking no 15-footers. Give me the ball on the post and I'm going to try to break the rim on you. I'm maximizing what I'm great at. Well, Wemby offensively, remember, it's two-sided sport. Offensively, who was he night to night? A three-point shooter, a jump shooter. Some nights he wants to be a floating man. He didn't know who he really, he don't know what his offense is.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas argues Victor Wembanyama is not a top-10 player
quotes.excerpt: That means he's not top 10.

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: Not even close is crazy. That means he's not top 10.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Is he not top 10?

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: No, no, no, no. No, no. No, no. When you're talking about the best player, listen, what makes you great when you're in the NBA is when the potential is not being potential anymore and you are becoming an assassin at what you do.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas compares Victor Wembanyama to Allen Iverson
quotes.excerpt: He is the big man Allen Iverson in a sense.
quotes.quote: He is the big man Allen Iverson in a sense where, when you try to push up on Allen, because he was so light and he's moving at a speed, you're pushing him. You're not fouling him, but because he's moving so fast and you get to try to control him and he's falling all over the place, foul, two free throws. God damn. Now you're sitting on, now you can't touch the fastest man and the quickest dude in the game because every time you did touch him, because he was so light, it's a foul to him.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas admits Victor Wembanyama is still learning
quotes.excerpt: He has not figured out how to be consistent.

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: He has not figured out his offensive game.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: He hasn't figured out how to be consistent.

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: Consistent, yeah.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton and Gilbert Arenas debate Victor Wembanyama's ranking
quotes.excerpt: He's top five, Gil. He's top five.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: He's top five, Gil. He's top five.

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: In today's game, he's top five now.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas ranks his top players
quotes.excerpt: I'm taking Wemby over Giannis.

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: You got Luka, you got Giannis, you got Shai, you got Jokic, you got Kevin Durant.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I'm taking Wemby over Giannis.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on Giannis Antetokounmpo's defensive and offensive impact
quotes.excerpt: Giannis defensively, he's top 10 on both ends of the court.
quotes.quote: If you're talking about Giannis, defensively, he's top 10 on both ends of the court, which is very different. So I look at it like that. If you start him off as top five starting off this season, I will say all right, someone has to earn it.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas discusses Jalen Brunson's consistency
quotes.excerpt: Brunson is one of those players where, because his game is not splashed, you don't really dissect.
quotes.quote: Then you got a guy like Jalen Brunson. And Brunson is one of those players where, because his game is not splashed, you don't really dissect his greatness, which is finishing that game off and being consistent at what he does, and you won't have him as a top five player and you're going to have to argue for him every year.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas and Theo Pinson discuss AI vs. Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: Who are you taking?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Who are you taking?

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: I'm going to go Allen Iverson. Because he's a superstar.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I want more, come on. Brunson not a superstar?

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: No, no, no. No, no, no, no. I need, remember, this is my first pick. I need someone that I know if I don't make no other picks, he can carry his team by himself. He don't need no other pieces.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on Allen Iverson's ability to carry a team
quotes.excerpt: I don't know what Allen would look like with the perfect pieces around him.
quotes.quote: I don't know what Allen would look like with the perfect pieces around him on the offensive end. We know what Brunson looks like. So I'm going to take Brunson when I want to win because I know he's going to figure out how to get it done.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on organizational impact on player success
quotes.excerpt: Some people are getting judged because of the organization wasn't smart enough.
quotes.quote: Some people are getting judged because of the organization wasn't smart enough. When we talk about Allen Iverson going to the championship with the team he had, we can look at them defensively, solid team. Offensively, he needs more help. You're going against Kobe and Shaquille O'Neal. And it's just Allen Iverson. The following year, who'd you give Allen Iverson?

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton and Gilbert Arenas on Allen Iverson's supporting cast
quotes.excerpt: Who did he get? Eric Snow.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Who did he get? Eric Snow.

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: Who did you give him the next year to go compete in that? And usually most people's careers fall short to the organizational handicap.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on Jalen Brunson's supporting cast
quotes.excerpt: The cast around Brunson too is in tuned with him.
quotes.quote: You're talking about Brunson did what Brunson did, but you got to remember the cast around Brunson too is in tuned with him. It goes how he goes. They're feeding the engine. Right? So he has enough pieces that's feeding the engine. Like, Allen Iverson never had a cat.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas and Raymond Felton on Chris Webber
quotes.excerpt: Chris Webber. He was not the same Chris Webber.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Chris Webber.

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: He was not the same Chris Webber. That's not, that's not, come on man. That's not, that's not Sacramento Chris Webber.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on Chris Webber's time in Philadelphia
quotes.excerpt: That's me and Memphis.
quotes.quote: That's me and Memphis. I'm just this. I'm just this. That's me and Memphis.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on the time needed for team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: How many years do they actually give that team a chance to actually gel?
quotes.quote: How many years do they actually give that team a chance to actually gel? You still got those two superstars. Think like one year. No, it was more than one year. It was for sure. Half a year, it was a year and a half.
